title: RSF Drones Hit Khartoum, Atbara, and El-Damer at Dawn, Breaking Months of Calm in Capital
detail: Drones struck Sudan's capital Khartoum and the northern cities of Atbara and El-Damer at dawn on August 12, 2026 (around 0300 GMT), in what appeared to be a coordinated RSF strike ending months of relative calm in Khartoum since the army recaptured the capital in 2025. Witnesses in Atbara and El-Damer and an AFP correspondent in Khartoum reported drones overhead; SAF air defenses fired anti-aircraft missiles from the Wadi Seidna base north of Omdurman in response. There were no immediate reports of casualties. The strikes follow the RSF's recent battlefield setbacks in North Kordofan and commander Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo's (Hemedti) late-July vow to 'unleash' his fighters and mobilize renewed operations toward Khartoum and Kordofan.

title: RSF Drone Strike on El Obeid Kills Two, Targets 5th Infantry Division Base
detail: A Rapid Support Forces drone strike hit El Obeid, the North Kordofan state capital, at dawn on August 12, 2026, as part of the same coordinated wave that struck Khartoum, Atbara, and El-Damer. The strike killed at least two people and injured six others, with the army's Fifth Infantry Division base the apparent target; division air defenses responded to the attack.

title: Emergency Lawyers Accuses SAF of Killing Civilians Northeast of Jabra El Sheikh
detail: The Emergency Lawyers group reported that Sudanese Armed Forces personnel in an armed military vehicle killed at least five civilians and wounded more than 10 others northeast of Jabra El Sheikh (Jabrat al-Shaikh), North Kordofan, on August 12, 2026, targeting farmers, shepherds, and other unarmed civilians in their homes, farms, and grazing grounds. No active combat was reported in the area at the time of the incident. Among the dead were Sheikh Awadallah Abdullah and his son; soldiers reportedly detained several other civilians before withdrawing. The legal group said the incident could constitute a war crime and called for an independent investigation.
